note.clipboard_failed: Could not paste rich clipboard content
note.clipboard_partial: Some clipboard content was not supported; losses
note.recognition_stale: The document changed. Recognize the formula again.
note.no_caret_map: The caret was not placed: the pages on screen and the editing copy diverged, so a caret would land on the wrong line. Clicks and arrows do not move it
note.field_text: This text is a field: a reference or a substitution. The field would overwrite an edit, so it cannot be changed here
note.tracked_text: The paragraph has tracked changes. Accept or reject them before changing the text
note.mixed_run: This place holds a tab, a break, a symbol or a picture as well as text. That edit cannot be made
note.inline_object: The paragraph holds an object this edit does not change: a link, a formula or a content control
note.opaque_drawing: The picture is kept without parsed markup and cannot be changed
note.wrong_target: The command addresses an object of another kind
note.indivisible: A content control cannot be split across two paragraphs
note.unsupported: This part of the text cannot be changed
note.stale_edit: The document changed during the edit. Try again
note.invalid_paragraph: This place is not a paragraph that can be edited
note.invalid_range: The selection runs past the text
note.invalid_text: The text holds a character a paragraph cannot contain
note.unknown_style: Style "{detail}" is missing or is of another kind
note.edit_limit: The document or the edit is past the limits under which it can be changed
note.empty_history: There is nothing to undo or redo
note.protected: Part of the text is protected from replacement: a field, a tracked change or another object that cannot be rewritten
note.unsupported_move: A move between different parts of the document is not done
note.selection_structure: The selection crosses a table or another container - delete it in parts
note.select_text: Select text or put the caret in a word
note.imported_text: Document text inserted; formatting and linked objects were not transferred
note.no_revisions: The document has no tracked changes
note.not_in_table: Put the caret in a table
note.cannot_edit_here: The text cannot be changed here: the selection takes in a tab, a break or an object between pieces of text
note.recognized_nothing: Nothing was recognised in the picture
note.bookmark_name: A bookmark name: letters, digits and "_", starting with a letter
note.notes_in_body: Notes go into the body text only
note.comments_in_body: Comments go on the body text only

model.duplicate_id: One story uses the same paragraph identifier twice
model.text_id: A paragraph has a text identifier and no paragraph identifier
model.sections: The section list and the section breaks disagree
model.section_boundary: The edit would delete, join or move a section break
model.bookmark: A bookmark has a start or an end and not both
model.comment: A comment range has a start or an end and not both
model.field: Field marks do not pair: a field has no matching start and end
model.table: A table, a row or a cell has an invalid shape
model.numbering: The list is unknown or its level is invalid
model.style_chain: A style chain is cyclic or out of date
model.header: A header or footer names a part that is not there
model.frame: A frame has a negative size
model.grid: A grid column width is not positive
model.note_ref: A note reference names a note that is not there
model.drawing: A picture has no image file, or its size is negative
model.definition_exists: That style or list definition already exists
model.definition_missing: The style or list definition is not there
model.definition_in_use: That definition is still used, or it is the default of its kind
model.other: The edit was stopped so it would not damage the document structure

about.text: MultiFormatEditor shows what the strict-ooxml Rust library can do: reading WordprocessingML Strict and Transitional, importing RTF, converting PDF and DjVu, recognizing scans, layout, transactional editing with undo, and saving.
about.features: Formats: DOCX, RTF, PDF, DjVu; saving: Strict DOCX, PDF, SVG, TXT. Interface: egui, localization from JSON.

cleanup.title: Clean up document
cleanup.tip: Clean document formatting and use AI to find accidental paragraph breaks
cleanup.intro: Choose improvements. Review the proposed changes first; meaning and wording are preserved.
cleanup.trailing: Remove spaces and tabs at paragraph ends
cleanup.empty: Keep at most one consecutive empty paragraph
cleanup.zero_width: Remove invisible U+200B and U+FEFF separators
cleanup.joins: AI: find sentences accidentally split into paragraphs
cleanup.protected: Tables, fields, links, comments, objects, page breaks, revisions and recognized code blocks are skipped. Non-breaking spaces are preserved.
cleanup.ai_failed: AI analysis did not finish. Technical cleanup is available without paragraph joins.
cleanup.review_hint: Dots show spaces, [TAB] shows tabs, ¶ marks paragraph boundaries. Select AI joins manually. One Undo reverts the entire set.
cleanup.stale: The document changed after analysis. Find improvements again.
cleanup.join: AI: join two parts of one sentence
cleanup.indent_changed: A first-line indent will also be set
